+def _quota_intervals(data, capacity, tie):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    if mandatory & blocked or len(mandatory) > k:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    best_ids = None
+    best_value = None
+    for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids) or ids & blocked:
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        active = []
+        valid = True
+        for job in sorted(subset, key=lambda row: (row["start"], row["end"])):
+            active = [end for end in active if end > job["start"]]
+            active.append(job["end"])
+            if len(active) > capacity:
+                valid = False
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+        selected = sorted(ids)
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and
+                 (selected < best_ids if tie == "smallest" else selected > best_ids))):
+            best_ids, best_value = selected, value
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+

+def _build_quota_solver(capacity, tie):
+    return lambda data: _quota_intervals(data, capacity, tie)
